name: Mary The Mother Of Jesus
overview: Scripture reveals Mary as the virgin chosen by God to bear His Son, fulfilling the prophecy of Isaiah that a virgin would conceive and bring forth Immanuel. The angel's greeting to Mary highlights her favor with God and her unique role in salvation history. Through the power of the Holy Spirit, she was overshadowed to conceive Jesus, the Son of God, demonstrating God's miraculous intervention in the incarnation. Mary’s humble faith is evident when she questions how this will occur, trusting in God's sovereign plan.
